sentences.da: Jamen det er jo ærlig snak, og i modsætning til den socialdemokratiske ordfører er det også det rigtige beslutningsforslag, der bliver kommenteret her.
sentences.en: That is, of course, honest talk, and unlike the Socialist rapporteur, it is also the right resolution that is being commented on here.

sentences.da: Hvad synes ordføreren om, at den her lovændring har så stor negativ indvirkning også for danske hjemløse?
sentences.en: What does the rapporteur think about this amendment of the law having such a negative effect on the Danish homeless as well?

sentences.da: Jeg vil gerne spørge den socialdemokratiske ordfører, om han vil pålægge Danmarks Radio i deres public service-kontrakt at købe fodboldrettigheder.
sentences.en: I would like to ask the Socialist rapporteur whether he will impose on Danmarks Radio in their public service contract to buy football rights.

sentences.da: Jeg vil gerne høre ordføreren, om han mener, at Danmark bør melde sig ud af EU.
sentences.en: I would like to hear from the rapporteur whether he thinks that Denmark should resign from the European Union.

sentences.da: Jeg forsøgte i sidste omgang to gange at stille samme spørgsmål, og jeg er så ked af, at jeg ikke fik et svar, for det var så ligetil et spørgsmål.
sentences.en: I tried to ask the same question twice last time, and I am so sorry that I did not get an answer, because it was so straightforward to ask a question.

sentences.da: Spørgsmålet lød, om Venstre synes, at dagpengereformen er en succes.
sentences.en: The question was whether the Left thinks that the unemployment benefit reform is a success.
